reason: An operator's Stop (or Resume) of assistant browser control could answer 409 'revision conflict' and leave the Assistant in control: BrowserCompanion.takeover saved assistant_paused with the revision it had just read, while the viewer's 3 s tab poll rewrote the same BrowserSession row on every call and a reconnect wrote it too; the viewer only showed the storage error in its generic notice. Core writers of that row now apply their own fields to the row as stored and retry when another writer saved first, the tab poll writes nothing when nothing changed, revoking pending approvals survives a concurrent decision, and the viewer keeps a Stop or Resume that Core did not confirm on screen with a retry. The assistant-browser-viewer spec now checks the draft-scoped session the viewer has on screen (it checked the fixture's prepared one since 5101be4) and gains a refused-Stop journey. Selected: the new Core race tests (6, all fail on main), the companion, viewer-endpoint and one-browser suites that exercise takeover, open, bind, select_tab and the tab poll, the companion stream route, the viewer component suite (5 new cases fail on main) and the assistant-browser-viewer area on its eight profiles (two journeys each).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_harnesses.py browser gateway cases (rechecks conversation binding, refuses paused control, refuses a change paused while its page is read) fail identically on pristine origin/main (8fe806a, rechecked after #1059) and on this branch (category 'execution_failed' instead of 'permission_denied'/'unavailable_resource'), so they are not selected. tests/v3/test_browser_host.py is not selected: test_identity_proxy_rechecks_durable_revocation_and_deletion fails identically on main (the test calls the now-async authorize without awaiting it) and the file does not reach the changed code. tests/v3/test_runtime_browser_bridge.py spawns real workers; with per-worktree Python 3.12 venvs it passes 14 with 4 skipped on both main and this branch, but its pytest process does not exit afterwards on either tree here, so it is left to a separate fix. python_browser is set because test_browser_companion.py has one real-Chromium capture case. The mocked interface journeys that click the same control (area:browser) are not selected: its two landscape entries fail on pristine main (hiding the browser controls moves the page 58 px and the test expects more than 70) and its degraded-Core case failed 1 of 5 runs on main on WebKit landscape; its desktop entry passed 5 of 5 on main and on this branch locally. ElectronBrowser.tsx (desktop shell) is unchanged and has no test here. No native code changed. PostgreSQL parametrizations run where NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is set. The scratch supervisor-Core journey on a LAN origin is recorded in the PR, not executed by CI.
